accounts.title: Payment accounts
accounts.intro: Members pay dues and event fees straight into your own account. {brandName} never holds the money and takes no share of it at checkout.
accounts.selectOwner: Select a district or club to manage its payment accounts.
accounts.noCoverage: No supported payment gateway can receive payments in {country} yet. You can still record payments received offline.
accounts.empty: No account connected yet. Until one is, dues campaigns and event links cannot take online payments.
accounts.webhookHelp: Register this address with {gateway} so payments are confirmed even when the payer closes the browser.

connect.title: Connect a payment account
connect.description: Paste the keys from your gateway dashboard. They are checked with the gateway before they are saved, and can never be read back.

stripe.secretKeyHint: Starts with rk_live_ (or rk_test_ for testing). Needs write access to Checkout Sessions and Refunds.
stripe.webhookSecretHint: Starts with whsec_. Shown when you add the webhook endpoint in Stripe.

paypal.clientIdHint: From your PayPal REST app (live, or sandbox for testing).
paypal.clientSecretHint: Shown next to the client ID in the PayPal developer dashboard.
paypal.webhookIdHint: The ID PayPal assigns when you add the webhook URL to the app.
